output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-d16e62cf8287] is only a metric name. But the section it belongs to [ev-1f419676f177] says what changes: metrics that started with `cortex_` will now start with `loki_`, because the default `metrics_namespace` is `loki`. Operators can keep the `cortex_` prefix by setting `metrics_namespace` to `cortex`, though that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. So the subject is the metric `cortex_ruler_client_request_duration_seconds_count`, and the change is a rename to `loki_ruler_client_request_duration_seconds_count`; environments are exposed if `metrics_namespace` is left at its default. The section does not say what happens if operators do nothing, but a metric rename concretely means anything that looks up the old name no longer finds this series.
